title: print (server to Polis)
description: Print round N again (the arbiter pressed it in OpenPairings or in Manubrium). Acted on only for the round the station holds; the server sends that round first. `standings` prints the standings frame the server sent just before (`server-standings`); `playerlist` is the players of the round in alphabetical order with board and room; `slips` is one result slip per board. A station that does not know a `what` ignores the frame.
